test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about nutrients are correct?

Statement A: C, H, O, N, P and K are macro nutrients.

Statement B: Fe, Mn, Ni, Co and Mo are micronutrients.

Statement C: Micronutrients are not essential for our body.

options.text: All statements A, B and C

solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statements A and B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Macro nutrients** include elements such as Carbon (C), Hydrogen (H), Oxygen (O), Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), and Potassium (K).
 
• **Micro nutrients** include elements like Iron (Fe), Manganese (Mn), Nickel (Ni), Cobalt (Co), and Molybdenum (Mo).
 
• Both macro and micronutrients are essential for plant growth and human health, though required in different quantities.
 
• Statement C is incorrect because micronutrients, despite being needed in smaller amounts, are essential for various bodily functions and overall health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Macronutrients:** These are nutrients required in larger amounts and include carbohydrates, proteins, and fats, along with elements like C, H, O, N, P, and K.
 
• **Micronutrients:** These are nutrients required in smaller amounts but are crucial for various physiological functions. Examples include vitamins and minerals like Fe, Mn, Ni, Co, and Mo.
 
• **Essential Nutrients:** Both macro and micronutrients are categorized as essential because the body cannot synthesize them in sufficient amounts.
 
• **Role of Micronutrients:** Micronutrients play vital roles in enzyme function, hormone production, and maintaining the immune system.
 
• **Deficiency Impacts:** Deficiency of micronutrients can lead to various health issues, including anemia (iron deficiency), scurvy (vitamin C deficiency), and osteoporosis (calcium deficiency).
